Package model.loot

Class Loot

java.lang.Object
model.loot.Loot
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Gold, Treasure
public abstract class Loot extends Object implements Serializable
Represents Loot on the floor during gameplay.

Contains the shared characteristics and behaviors between different types of loot. Different types of loot share display and Position information, differing on effects on pick-up.

    • pickUpLoot

      public abstract void pickUpLoot(Floor floor)
      Allows the Player to claim the loot.

      Each subclass of loot must define what it gives on pick-up.

      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the loot is on, allows it to use the floor's Random seed and give loot to the Player.
